title: Time-bounded tabulation circuit family
statement: Given a deterministic Turing machine $M$ and natural numbers $C$ and $d$, define the circuit family whose circuit on inputs of length $n$ is the tabulation circuit for $M$ with empty initial tape contents and time bound $(C+1)(n+1)^d$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a deterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet.
